{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Count total rows
total_rows = len(sales)

# Count QA orders
qa_count = len(qa_orders)

# Count rows after removing QA orders
non_qa_rows = len(sales) - qa_count

# Count completed orders among non-QA rows
completed_orders = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
completed_count = len(completed_orders)

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"QA orders: {qa_count}")
print(f"Non-QA rows: {non_qa_rows}")
print(f"Completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_count}")"}
